item.title: OwnDB: An Attempt At Democratizing Database
item.description: OwnDB started as an experiment to make self-hosting PostgreSQL as simple as using a managed database. Along the way, we explored agentless provisioning, SSH-based infrastructure management, secrets management, and the challenges of turning a proof of concept into a production-ready database platform.
